SELECT shop.Name
FROM shop
JOIN hiring ON shop.Shop_ID = hiring.Shop_ID
GROUP BY shop.Shop_ID, shop.Name
ORDER BY COUNT(hiring.Employee_ID) DESC
LIMIT 1;
FINAL SQL:
SELECT shop.Name
FROM shop
JOIN hiring ON shop.Shop_ID = hiring.Shop_ID
GROUP BY shop.Shop_ID, shop.Name
ORDER BY COUNT(hiring.Employee_ID) DESC
LIMIT 1;
